descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S10 Medication rows: status × last mention × chart last processed → kept or deleted

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 Hospital active medication rows are deleted 36 h after their last mention: an active row not mentioned for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: active med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U6 Hospital held and stopped medication rows are deleted at 36 h, and a held row's clock restarts each time the chart is processed: a held row not refreshed for 37 h is gone. (UAT OAT-04 (B); UAT OAT-04 step 1; UAT 3.6; TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: held/stopped med rows)) — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

Test design technique: Decision table (decision-table) — List the combinations of several conditions and check each one, to see that the result follows the rule.

Given One Hospital patient per cell, aged by the aging helper

When The purge runs; raw medication rows read

Then Active, mention 35 h: kept. Active, mention 37 h, chart processed 2 h ago: deleted. Held, mention 37 h, processed 2 h or 35 h ago: kept. Held, mention 4 days, processed 2 h ago: kept. Held, mention and processing both 37 h: deleted. Stopped, mention and processing both 37 h: deleted. Stopped, mention 37 h, processed 2 h ago: judged per Q16. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT 3.6 ('all rows (active, held, stopped) cleared at 36 h; held rows are refreshed each time the chart is processed'), OAT-04 (B), the TFA-94699 table and TC-19 Expected 8 (a single-dose row 'expires', no window given). Every cell has one expected outcome except stopped x processed 2 h ago, single-dose and changed, which are reported against both readings (Q16). …

Where it ran: local retention (clock moved to check retention); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: manual (blocked)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-04.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 43c38a4f (10-15 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane retention.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: retention.
